resolved_product_findings.title: Tool-bearing delivery checks ran after the final complete byte witness
resolved_product_findings.readback: handoff.delivery_guards performs check_experimental_preview and every p.check_experimental_local_settings call before invoking material. The remaining field-local-settings, process and local.check_event readers do not call the selected tool checker. child_findings_resolved_during_review.title: Custom passed flag and exit code survived shared publication invalidation
child_findings_resolved_during_review.original_counterexample: A successful body sets passed=true, then f.publish encounters a late freshness/readback failure and changes status to invalidated. The initial child account callback did not clear passed for that status, and its return code checked passed alone.
child_findings_resolved_during_review.readback: account now clears passed whenever status is not completed; the return code requires both passed and completed. This also covers cancelled and invalidated outcomes raised by f.publish.

child_findings_resolved_during_review.title: Protocol board_name could name a board outside the owned fixture packet
child_findings_resolved_during_review.original_counterexample: The initial child validated fixture_files names but joined an unchecked absolute or parent-relative board_name to source. That could route a different source while stable continued checking the unused freshly written fixture packet.
child_findings_resolved_during_review.readback: board_name now must be a flat .kicad_pcb string present in both fixture_files and fixture_sha256. After route, the receipt source must equal that owned board and source_hashes must equal the freshly written packet inventory.

child_scope_reviewed: Frozen caller protocol SHA and exact curated interpreter/venv checks precede toolchain construction; tool context comes from the caller protocol, not a delivery receipt.
Fresh output, owned destination, immutable source packet, protocol/tool/runtime stability checks, and retained whole evidence inventory are required.

The intended fresh Route, rendered review, software accept intent, fresh Native export and current shared export reader remain distinct; source/open, final finding counts, pinned metrics version and locked KEEP route predictions are explicit.
Default Route, review-context, choice binding and export consumers must specifically raise p.Rejected for the explicit experimental records.
Software intent remains distinct from human approval/application. The child retains accepted=false, production_admitted=false, actual_GUI=false and human_review=false.

The child enforces a 172-second remaining wall/full-CPU allowance, reserves export/publication time, and asks f.publish for a final replay. A frozen outer controller is still required to enforce the complete prepare-through-cleanup budget, shared foreground lock, one worker, network denial, process/RSS/log/scratch limits, and terminal process/status/flag qualification. Those outer provisions were not yet reviewed or run.
